_: Packs that are finished but deliberately not yet wired into prose.js.
verify.py hard-fails on a pack nobody imports, because that is normally a
translation nobody can read. An entry here turns that failure into a
warning that names the reason, so the work is visible every single run
Delete an entry the moment its pack is reachable.
The original reason both spells and monsters were here -- prose.js
imported every pack statically, so wiring a big one would drop a megabyte
of Italian into the bundle an English reader downloads -- is gone. The
packs now load as one lazy chunk per language. monsters was registered the
same day and its entry removed.
